sources.title: Planning pre-application advice service
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's pre-application service gives policy-based advice and explicitly does not guarantee that a proposal will be successful; it can identify issues before formal submission.

sources.title: Fast Track Decision Service
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Fast Track service applies to specified lawful-development-certificate classes, targets a 15-working-day decision after payment or validation, and explicitly does not guarantee the outcome.

sources.title: Planning application process
sources.verified_claim: Havering encourages pre-application engagement particularly for major or complex proposals; advice may indicate acceptability or changes but is not a decision or permission.

sources.title: Validation checklists
sources.verified_claim: Havering publishes application-type validation checklists and requires submitted plans and documents to satisfy national and local requirements before an application can progress.

sources.title: Validation of your application
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth checks whether sufficient information has been provided, normally within five days; incomplete applications are invalid and assessment does not start until required information is received.

sources.title: Prepare and submit your application
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth requires forms, drawings, documents and fees under its Local Information Requirements and notes incomplete applications can cause delays and extra charges; submission completeness is not planning approval.

sources.title: Assessing your application
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth assesses land use, design, amenity, transport, sustainability, access and consultation responses and may require S106 where necessary; assessment remains proposal-specific.

sources.title: London Infrastructure Framework
sources.verified_claim: The London Infrastructure Framework identifies strategic transport, energy, water, waste and digital infrastructure needs through 2050 to support housing, jobs and resilience; framework inclusion does not establish delivery at a sample parcel.
